$comment: Hand-written field meanings for generated documentation (scripts/lib/field-descriptions.js). Used only where the declaring property in source has no comment. A key is a field name, or `parent.field` where the name means different things in different places; a name with no single meaning is left out. Times are ISO-8601 strings; amounts are in the currency's major unit, rounded to its decimals (services/money.ts).

fields.organizationId: Id of the organization (tenant) the record belongs to.
fields.branchId: Id of the branch the record belongs to or applies to.
fields.defaultBranchId: Id of the branch used when a request names none.
fields.primaryBranchId: Id of the member's primary (default) branch.
fields.membershipId: Id of a membership: one user in one organization (`<uid>_<organizationId>`).
fields.createdByMembershipId: Membership id of the member who created the record.
fields.completedByMembershipId: Membership id of the member who completed the task.
fields.actorMembershipId: Membership id of the member who performed the action.
fields.userId: Firebase Auth uid of the user.
fields.ownerUserId: Firebase Auth uid of the organization's Owner (null until an Owner is provisioned).
fields.actorUid: Firebase Auth uid of the user who performed the action.
fields.roleId: Id of the role that grants the member's permissions.
fields.jobRoleId: Id of the job role (job title) assigned to the member.
fields.departmentId: Id of the department the member belongs to.
fields.expenseCategoryId: Id of the expense category the outflow is booked under.
fields.outflowId: Id of the outflow (purchase or expense).
fields.templateId: Id of the recurring expense template.
fields.lineId: Id of a line within its document.
fields.logId: Id of the audit log entry.
fields.requestId: Id of the approval request or client request this entry belongs to.
fields.deviceId: Id of the user's device (one per installation).
fields.entityType: Kind of record the entry refers to (organization, product, bill, …).
fields.entityId: Id of the record the entry refers to.
fields.id: Id of this item, unique within its list.
fields.createdBy: Firebase Auth uid of the user who created the record.
fields.updatedAt: Time the record was last changed (ISO-8601).
fields.updatedBy: Firebase Auth uid of the user who last changed the record.
fields.approvedBy: Firebase Auth uid of the approver.
fields.rejectedBy: Firebase Auth uid of the user who rejected it.
fields.approvalNote: Note recorded with the approval decision.
fields.voidedBy: Firebase Auth uid of the user who voided the document.
fields.expiryDate: Expiry date of the batch received on this line (YYYY-MM-DD).
fields.name: Human-readable name of this record.
fields.displayName: Short name shown in the app instead of the legal name.
fields.title: Short title.
fields.status: Lifecycle status of the record (values: the field's enum).
fields.isActive: Whether the record is active (inactive records are kept, not deleted).
fields.isDefault: Whether this is the default entry of its list.
fields.isPrimary: Whether this is the primary entry of its list.
fields.isSystem: Whether the record is built in (system-defined) rather than created by an organization.
fields.nextCursor: Cursor for the next page (pass it back as the request's cursor); null on the last page.
fields.totalCount: Number of matching records in total.
fields.reason: Reason code or text explaining the outcome.
fields.action: The action that was performed (audit action name).
fields.field: Name of the field that changed.
fields.altPhone: Alternative phone number in E.164 format.
fields.additionalPhones: Further phone numbers in E.164 format.
fields.contactPerson: Name of the person to contact.
fields.notifyBy: How this contact wants to be notified.
fields.currencyDecimals: Number of decimals the currency uses for amounts (ISO 4217 exponent).
fields.timezone: IANA time zone used for the organization's dates and reports.
fields.businessType: Kind of business (retail, wholesale or both); sets module and sales defaults.
fields.graceDays: Days after expiry during which the organization keeps access.
fields.daysRemaining: Whole days left until the subscription ends.
fields.ownerStatus: Whether the organization's Owner account is provisioned (active) or still pending.
fields.salesMode: How sales are made by default (POS, invoice, …).
fields.address.label: Label of the address (Head office, Warehouse, …).
fields.address.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the address.
fields.address.contactName: Person to contact at this address.
fields.addresses.label: Label of the address (Head office, Warehouse, …).

fields.addresses.contactName: Person to contact at this address.
fields.isDefaultBilling: Whether this address is used for billing by default.
fields.isDefaultShipping: Whether this address is used for shipping by default.
fields.bankAccounts.label: Label of the bank account.
fields.routingType: Kind of routing code (IFSC, IBAN, SWIFT, US routing, other).

fields.image.path: Storage path of the processed image.

fields.amount: Amount in the currency's major unit.

fields.grossAmount: Line amount before discount and tax.

fields.returnedQty: Quantity already returned from this line.

fields.creditLimit: Maximum outstanding balance allowed for the party.
fields.creditPeriodDays: Days of credit given to the party.

fields.payeeType: Who is paid (vendor, employee or other).
fields.referenceModel: Kind of document the entry refers to.
fields.billNumber: Sequential bill number, unique per organization and document type.
fields.paymentStatus: Payment state of the document (unpaid, partially paid, paid).
fields.attachmentPaths: Storage paths of files attached to the document.
fields.wholesalePrice: Selling price per unit for wholesale.
fields.mrp: Maximum retail price printed on the product.
fields.lowStockThreshold: Stock level at which the product counts as low on stock.
fields.reorderLevel: Stock level at which the product should be reordered.

fields.isDiscountable: Whether discounts may be given on the product.
fields.isSaleOnly: Whether the product is only sold, never purchased.

fields.isExpenseOnly: Whether the item is booked only as an expense.

fields.sharingPolicies.products: Whether products are shared by all branches or kept per branch.
fields.sharingPolicies.categories: Whether categories are shared by all branches or kept per branch.

fields.roleCode: Code of the member's role (org_owner, admin, employee, …).
